**Products, 1**

### [Bombora (Company Surge)](../tools/bombora.md)

Detects which companies are actively researching specific B2B topics by aggregating content-consumption data (article reads, downloads) across a co-op of 5,000+ B2B publisher sites, then measures spikes in a company's topic-research volume relative to its own...

**What this page does not claim**

A listed tool has not been run: the catalogue says what an agent could try, not what works. 1 of 784 directory entries are bench tested, meaning somebody personally ran the tool on a stated date, and 0 of this vendor's 1 product are among them. There is no verdict here on whether this vendor is better than another.
